subject: Service load spike — Sylvan Works VPC performance & exec handoff
messages:
From: Helena Quinn <helena.quinn@sylvanworks.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: urgent: token latency & 500s from our private VPC

Hi Naomi,

We started seeing a big regresssion on our Redwood private deployment this morning (since ~07:50 PST). p95 token latency across our inference routes has gone from ~160ms to ~520ms and we are seeing 500s that correlate with long decode times. Impact: checkout elastic search enrichment and our personalization scoring are timing out — several live customers reported failures.

We attached the logs and a small KPI snapshot. The spike lines up with a batch job the team kicked off (nightly personalization rebuild) but the spike continues well past completion. Can you confirm if anything changed on your side (kernel/quantization rollout, routing changes, config push) and engage engineering immediately? This is causing revenue impact — we need executive visibility if this can't be stabilized in the next hour.

Attachments: sylvan-logs-20280320.tar.gz, sylvan-kpis-20280320.csv

Helena Quinn
CTO, Sylvan Works
helena.quinn@sylvanworks.com
ops@sylvanworks.com

On a side note, if you need us to throttle the personalization job we can do that but want to avoid too much manual changes without root cause.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Helena Quinn <helena.quinn@sylvanworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: urgent: token latency & 500s from our private VPC

Helena — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. I'm escalating this to our on-call performance team now (cc'ing Marissa and Laura). We're treating this as high priority.

Immediate next steps:
- Marissa: can you grab the logs and run the hotpath trace?
- Laura: please pull route-level telemetry and any rollout records in the last 24h.
- Helena: if you can temporarily limit the personalization job to 40% of capacity that will help while we triage; we know you prefer no manual intervention but it will buy time.

I'll pull in execs if we can't stabilize within 45 minutes. Standby — I'll follow up with a short summary and proposed mitigations.

— Naomi

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Helena Quinn <helena.quinn@sylvanworks.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: urgent: token latency & 500s from our private VPC — please investigate (logs attached)

Forwarding Helena's note and the attached logs. Key context: Sylvan runs on a dedicated private deployment (VPC) with a nightly personalization rebuild that likely increased concurrent seq lengths and request burstiness. Customer reports ongoing latency/500s after job completed. They can throttle the job if needed — asking us to stabilize without that if possible.

Ask for eng: please run these diagnostics ASAP and reply with ETA and action plan. Suggested initial mitigations to test (in order of preference):
1) Short-term traffic shaping: limit personalization route concurrency and add a 2s circuit-breaker to reduce tail blocking.
2) Temporary model variant fallback: route heavy requests to a quantized variant with lower memory pressure (will trade small quality for latency).
3) Aggressive KV/prefix cache for common prompts (if applicable) and reduce batch size to lower p99 decode pressure.
4) If decode stalls look kernel/driver related, roll back last night's kernel/quantization packaging on the affected nodes.

Diagnostics to collect and paste in reply: stack traces around 07:45-09:00, kernel module load history, batch size distribution, and KV cache hit rates. I've attached the customer's log bundle.

Attachments: sylvan-logs-20280320.tar.gz

Thanks — Naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Helena Quinn <helena.quinn@sylvanworks.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: urgent: token latency & 500s from our private VPC — mitigation & exec summary

Team — quick post-mortem and current state. Actions taken (complete):
- Ingested Sylvan logs and ran hotpath trace: root cause appears to be a sustained increase in long-sequence inference requests from the nightly job combined with an opportunistic kernel memory fragmentation event on 3/20 07:42 (host-level).
- Applied temporary route concurrency caps for personalization and enabled a low-latency quantized model variant for 3 routes — p95 latency dropped from ~520ms to ~170ms within 12 minutes.
- Turned on aggressive KV prefix caching for the personalization bundle (cache warmed from saved snapshots in the log).
- Rolled back a recent micro-quantization packaging that touched the tensor-split kernel on the affected shard nodes.

Remaining work / next steps:
- We recommend Sylvan throttle the nightly job to 40% capacity for the next 48h while we monitor (Helena agreed offline).
- We'll leave the quantized fallback for 24h and then run an A/B quality check against holdback requests.
- Ops will run a host-level memory defragment and kernel stability check across the private pool this evening.

Executive ask: Naomi, please schedule a 30-minute executive sync (Sylvan CTO + Redwood ops lead + CS lead) to review impact and approve temporary throttle for the job window. If Sylvan prefers, we can propose a compensatory credit for customer SLA impact — Laura, can you prepare estimated usage credit?

Attachments: sylvan-kpis-20280320.csv

Thanks — Marissa Cole
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
